purpose: Support quality-management learning and evidence discipline relevant to ISO 9001 without claiming organisational conformity, certification, accreditation or auditor approval.
copyrightBoundary: Clause themes and app mappings are paraphrased. This file does not reproduce ISO 9001 requirement text and is not a substitute for a licensed copy of the applicable standard.

allowed: supports quality-management practices relevant to ISO 9001
provides learning, evidence prompts and record templates that can support an organisation's QMS
helps users structure objective evidence for review
forbidden: using MouldMaster makes an organisation ISO 9001 compliant
MouldMaster replaces a certification body, auditor, customer requirement or organisation-specific QMS

recordTemplates.title: Audit evidence record
recordTemplates.purpose: Capture what criterion was reviewed, what objective evidence was observed and what finding was made without turning the app into a certification audit.
rules: Do not quote protected ISO requirement text into the record unless your organisation is licensed to do so.
A finding records observed evidence against the organisation's chosen criterion; MouldMaster does not certify conformity.

recordTemplates.title: Nonconformity and corrective-action record
recordTemplates.purpose: Preserve containment, evidence, cause investigation, approved action and effectiveness verification as separate steps.
rules: Do not infer root cause from a defect label, model prediction or one successful intervention.
Closure requires recorded effectiveness evidence; action completion alone is not effectiveness proof.

recordTemplates.title: Measurement and calibration or verification evidence
recordTemplates.purpose: Record whether a measurement resource is fit for the intended decision and what traceable evidence supports its status.
rules: A capable production process does not prove that the measurement system is suitable.
Do not invent calibration status from a sticker, historical pass or process result.

recordTemplates.title: Competence evidence record
recordTemplates.purpose: Connect a role or authorization need to evidence of training, assessment or supervised demonstration.
rules: MouldMaster completion or a certificate is learning evidence, not employer authorization.
Role authorization remains an organisation decision.

recordTemplates.title: Documented-information and change-control record
recordTemplates.purpose: Keep the reason, approved change, affected evidence and verification visible when a process or controlled document changes.
rules: Do not silently overwrite the previous controlled state.
A new process setting is not validated merely because it was approved for a trial.

workflow.evidenceRule: Measured evidence, document identity, timing and responsible role should remain distinguishable. Missing data stays missing; do not reconstruct measurements after the event.

privacyBoundary: Use non-sensitive references rather than names, customer identifiers, site identifiers, proprietary part numbers, raw customer process data or private attachments in any public or training record.
transitionRule: When ISO publishes Edition 6, recheck the official ISO status page, update the requirements basis, compare clause themes, rerun QA and require a deliberate review before changing any conformity-support wording.
